newsitem.title: USA: U.S. FDA approves P&U latex allergy test.
newsitem.headline: U.S. FDA approves P&U latex allergy test.

text.p: Pharmacia & Upjohn's Diagnostics Division said Monday it had received clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market a new laboratory blood test for latex allergy.

The division said the serum test can identify immunoglobulin E antibodies specific to latex allergies. It can determine whether a patient is hypersensitive to latex within a few hours, the company said.
Latex allergies can cause everything from skin rashes to anaphylactic shock, and in some cases death, the company said.
